AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Leftover Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Integrated Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Organic Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
